answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed front-end types in openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts are stale. The change adds ScenarioChangelogOutput, a new INSTALL value on scenario_revision_reason, and a new scenario_update_changelogs field on ScenarioUpdatePreviewOutput, but the generated file was not regenerated. The check prints 'Forgot to generate types!' and exits 1. Rerunning will fail the same way; the fix is to run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
